title: CleanGutters Lighting vs The Gutter Guys: 2026 Verdict
body_markdown:
Choosing between CleanGutters Lighting and The Gutter Guys comes down to what you actually need done to your roofline. **Choose CleanGutters Lighting if you want surgical stainless steel micro-mesh installed by the owner himself, backed by a transferable lifetime warranty, plus the option to add permanent roofline LED lighting in the same visit.** Choose The Gutter Guys if you're after a standard local crew for routine cleaning or repair work and don't need guard technology or lighting bundled into the job. The real split is specialist versus generalist — one company builds its business around micro-mesh protection and owner-installed craftsmanship, the other operates like most traditional gutter outfits in the region.

This comparison breaks down how [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) stacks up against a typical local competitor like The Gutter Guys across installation, materials, warranty terms, pricing structure, and service area — no fluff, just the differences that change what ends up on your roofline.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting vs The Gutter Guys comes down to specialist micro-mesh installation versus generalist gutter cleaning and repair.
- CleanGutters Lighting installs stainless steel micro-mesh personally — Alex handles every job, not subcontractors.
- Transferable lifetime warranty on CleanGutters Lighting guards adds resale value that standard cleaning contracts don't.
- The Gutter Guys works fine if you just need seasonal cleaning or a basic repair, not guard protection.
- CleanGutters Lighting also installs permanent roofline LED lighting, a service most traditional gutter companies don't offer at all.




## Why this matters

Gutter guards and gutter cleaning solve different problems, and the company you hire determines whether the fix lasts one season or twenty years. A generalist crew that cleans gutters twice a year is solving a maintenance problem. A micro-mesh specialist is solving a debris-entry problem permanently, which is why the installation method and material quality matter more here than almost any other home exterior decision you'll make in 2026.

CleanGutters Lighting has installed protection on more than 1,000 homes across South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware since 2009, with stainless steel micro-mesh rated to handle over 22 inches of rain per hour without overflow. That's the kind of spec that separates a company built around one product from a crew that offers guards as an add-on to cleaning visits.

## At a glance

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | The Gutter Guys |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Micro-mesh guard installation + roofline lighting | Routine gutter cleaning and repair |
| Installation model | Owner-installed (Alex, personally) | Typical subcontracted crew model |
| Core material | Surgical stainless steel micro-mesh | Standard screens/foam (traditional model) |
| Warranty | Transferable lifetime warranty | Standard workmanship warranty (typical) |
| Additional services | Permanent roofline LED lighting | Cleaning and repair only |
| Pricing model | Flat project quote, no fine print | Per-visit or seasonal contract pricing |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern DE | Local service radius |
| Sales approach | No-pressure, no-obligation quote | Varies by crew |

## CleanGutters Lighting wins on installation accountability

When Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally, there's one person accountable for the seams, the pitch, and the fastening — not a rotating subcontractor crew. That matters because most gutter guard failures trace back to installation error, not the mesh itself: gaps at corners, wrong screw spacing, guards that don't match the fascia angle.

A generalist service like The Gutter Guys, if it follows the standard industry model most local crews use, typically dispatches whichever technician is available that day. That's fine for a cleaning visit. It's a bigger variable when you're installing something meant to last decades. **Verdict: CleanGutters Lighting, by a clear margin, for anyone who cares who actually touches their roofline.**

## Both handle basic gutter repair competently

Spot repairs, reattaching sagging sections, sealing minor leaks — this is bread-and-butter work for any established gutter company in the region, and there's no meaningful gap here. CleanGutters Lighting offers complete gutter repair services alongside its guard work, and a traditional outfit like The Gutter Guys is built around exactly this kind of maintenance call. **Verdict: tie — pick based on what else you need bundled into the visit.**

## CleanGutters Lighting offers a materially stronger guard product

Stainless steel micro-mesh is a different category from the standard screen or foam inserts most traditional gutter services install as an upsell. Micro-mesh blocks pine needles, shingle grit, and seed pods that standard screens let through, and homeowners with micro-mesh report 40-60% fewer clogs compared to open gutters or basic screens.

If The Gutter Guys operates like most generalist local companies, guards are a secondary line item rather than the core specialty. **Verdict: CleanGutters Lighting wins on guard technology, not close.**

## The Gutter Guys is the simpler call for one-off cleaning

If your gutters just need to be cleared before winter and you have no interest in a guard system, a straightforward cleaning-and-repair company is the lighter lift — fewer decisions, faster scheduling, no product research required. That's a legitimate reason to call a generalist crew instead of a guard specialist. **Verdict: The Gutter Guys, for homeowners who explicitly don't want guards installed.**

## CleanGutters Lighting's warranty terms are stronger

A transferable lifetime warranty on the guard installation adds resale value most standard workmanship warranties don't touch — it follows the house, not just the original buyer. Traditional cleaning and repair contracts typically carry standard, non-transferable warranty terms limited to the labor performed that visit.

For a home you plan to sell within the warranty period, this difference alone can justify the guard investment. **Verdict: CleanGutters Lighting, and it's not a small gap.**

## CleanGutters Lighting adds a service The Gutter Guys doesn't touch

Permanent architectural roofline LED lighting is a category most gutter cleaning and repair companies never offer, because it's a separate trade skill layered onto the same fascia line. CleanGutters Lighting bundles custom lighting installs with gutter and guard work in one project. **Verdict: CleanGutters Lighting wins by default — there's no comparable offering to weigh against it.**

## Pricing models: predictability vs pay-as-you-go

Neither company's specific pricing numbers belong in a comparison like this — rates shift, and you should always confirm current pricing directly. What's worth comparing is the *model*.

- **CleanGutters Lighting** quotes guard and lighting projects as a flat scope with no-pressure, no-fine-print terms — you know the full project cost before work starts.
- **The Gutter Guys**, following the standard model for cleaning-focused companies, typically prices per visit or seasonal contract, which is cheaper upfront for occasional cleanings but recurring over the life of the gutters.

If you want to stop paying for gutter maintenance altogether, a one-time guard installation trades a recurring cost for a fixed one. If you just need gutters cleared twice a year, the per-visit model costs less per transaction. **Verdict: tie — the right model depends on whether you're solving the problem once or managing it seasonally.**



## Service area and scheduling

CleanGutters Lighting covers South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware as a defined territory tied to owner-installed jobs, which caps how many projects go out each week but keeps quality consistent. A generalist crew-based company can typically cover more ground faster because multiple crews run simultaneously. **Verdict: The Gutter Guys likely wins on raw scheduling speed; CleanGutters Lighting wins on installation consistency.**

## Final verdict

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if:** you're a South Jersey, Eastern PA, or Northern Delaware homeowner who wants to stop cleaning gutters permanently, wants stainless steel micro-mesh installed by the same person every time, and likes the idea of adding roofline lighting to the same project. This is the stronger long-term investment for anyone planning to stay in the home for years or sell it with a transferable warranty attached.

**Choose The Gutter Guys if:** you need a single cleaning or repair visit, don't want to evaluate guard technology right now, and prioritize fast scheduling over installation consistency. This works for renters, short-term owners, or anyone with a small, low-debris roofline that doesn't justify a guard system yet.

| Scheduling speed | The Gutter Guys |

## FAQ


**Is CleanGutters Lighting better than The Gutter Guys?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the stronger choice for micro-mesh guard installation and roofline lighting, while a generalist company like The Gutter Guys fits better for a single cleaning or repair visit. The right pick depends on whether you want a one-time guard solution or ongoing maintenance.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting install gutter guards personally?**

Yes, Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally rather than dispatching subcontractors. That accountability is a core differentiator from crew-based local gutter services.

**What areas does CleanGutters Lighting serve?**

CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware in 2026, covering gutter guard installation, gutter cleaning and repair, and roofline lighting.

**Is stainless steel micro-mesh worth it over standard gutter screens?**

Micro-mesh blocks finer debris like pine needles and shingle grit that standard screens let through, and homeowners report 40-60% fewer clogs with micro-mesh compared to open gutters or basic screens.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting offer a warranty on gutter guards?**

CleanGutters Lighting backs its micro-mesh installations with a transferable lifetime warranty, meaning the coverage follows the house even after a sale.

**What is roofline LED lighting and does The Gutter Guys offer it?**

Roofline LED lighting is a permanent architectural lighting install along the fascia line, offered by CleanGutters Lighting alongside gutter services. Most traditional gutter cleaning and repair companies, including generalist crews, don't offer this as a bundled service.

**How long has CleanGutters Lighting been in business?**

CleanGutters Lighting has been operating since 2009, with more than 1,000 homes protected across its South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware service area as of 2026.

**How much rain can micro-mesh gutter guards handle?**

CleanGutters Lighting's stainless steel micro-mesh is built to handle over 22 inches of rain per hour without overflow, a benchmark well above typical seasonal storm rates in the region.


## One last thing

The detail that gets overlooked in most gutter guard comparisons: the warranty transfers with the house, not just the original buyer. If you're weighing a guard investment against a cleaning contract and you might sell within the next decade, that transferable lifetime warranty is the number that actually shows up on a home inspection report in 2026 — a recurring cleaning contract never does.
